summary.text: Jon Maples is the Republican candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 87, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he is a financial advisor who advanced from the August 18 Republican primary.
He lost the March 24, 2026 special general election for the same seat to Emily Gregory (D).

paragraphs.text: Maples was born and raised in Panama City, Florida, according to his Ballotpedia survey responses, and worked summers in his family's irrigation business.

The survey says he earned a basketball scholarship to Palm Beach Atlantic University, where he was a team captain and earned All-American honors; Ballotpedia lists his bachelor's degree there as 2005.
The survey says Maples has lived in Palm Beach County for more than 20 years and worked as a financial planner.
He won the special Republican primary for District 87 on January 13, 2026, defeating Gretchen Miller Feng, and lost the special general election to Emily Gregory, 51.2 percent to 48.8 percent.
Maples listed affordability and cost of living, public safety, and parental rights in education as his three key campaign messages.
